name: nervouscsstem
description: Mostly-pure CSS design system inspired by NERV's operational consoles from Neon Genesis Evangelion
author: Texarkanine <texarkanine@protonmail.com>

scripts.build: sass src/nerv.scss dist/nerv.css --no-source-map && cp src/nerv.js dist/nerv.js
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/foundation.test.mjs test/effects.test.mjs test/panels.test.mjs test/patterns.test.mjs test/components.test.mjs test/states.test.mjs test/publish-contract.test.mjs test/docs-assets.test.mjs test/skill-contract.test.mjs test/offline-bundle.test.mjs
scripts.docs:serve: npm run build && node scripts/resolve-docs-assets.mjs --mode local && uv run properdocs serve
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && node scripts/resolve-docs-assets.mjs --mode local && uv run properdocs build --strict
